'''Juan Alberto "Juancho" Hernangómez Geuer''' (born September 28, 1995) is a Spanish professional [[basketball]] player for [[CB Estudiantes|Movistar Estudiantes]] of the [[Liga ACB]]. He is also a member of the [[Spain national under-20 basketball team]] and has competed in international competition on three occasions.<ref name="realgm">{{cite web|title=Juan Alberto Hernangomez|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Juan-Alberto-Hernangomez/Summary/52816|website=[[RealGM]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref>

== Early career ==
Hernangómez began playing competitive basketball in 2007, with the youth teams of [[CB Las Rozas]]. He joined a youth squad of [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] and played with the team until moving to Club Baloncesto Majadahonda for the following years.<ref name="estudiantes">{{cite web|title=Juancho Hernangómez|url=http://clubestudiantes.com/frontend/clubestudiantes/noticia.php?id_noticia=10278&id_seccion=449|website=''ClubEstudiantes.com''|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref>

== Professional career ==
In 2012, Hernangómez signed his first professional contract with [[CB Estudiantes]] and competed with their second team until 2014, when he was promoted to the main team.<ref name=eurobasket/>

On June 13, 2016, Hernangómez was one of 13 international underclassmen to officially enter their names for the [[2016 NBA Draft]]. He is projected to be a late first round draft pick in this year's draft.

== International career ==
In 2013, Hernangómez competed with the [[Spain national under-18 basketball team]] at the [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] in [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|Latvia]]. He joined the [[Spain national under-18 basketball team|under-20 team]] for the following two years, playing at the [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]]. Hernangómez would also help the [[Spain national basketball team|official team]] in their practices for the [[EuroBasket 2015]].<ref name=eurobasket>{{cite web|title=Juancho Hernangomez profile|url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Juancho_Hernangomez/Spain/Tuenti_Movil_Estudiantes_Madrid/250378|website=[[Eurobasket.com]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Juancho Hernangomez and Alberto Abalde to help Spanish NT at practices|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/national-teams/national-teams/173992/juancho-hernangomez-and-alberto-abalde-to-help-spanish-nt-at-practices.html|website=Sportando|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref>

== Player profile ==
Hernangómez's style of play has drawn comparisons to [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] players [[Víctor Claver]] and [[Jonas Jerebko]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Juan Hernangomez|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/juan-hernangomez|website=NBADraft.net|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref> He has been praised for his speed, athleticism, and approximately {{convert|7|ft|m|0|abbr=off|adj=on}} wingspan.<ref>{{cite web|title=Juan Hernangomez|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Juan-Hernangomez-73096/|website=DraftExpress|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref> The duo of him and his brother, [[Willy Hernangómez|Guillermo]], have also been compared to Spanish NBA stars [[Marc Gasol|Marc]] and [[Pau Gasol]].<ref>{{cite web|title=The Hernangomez brothers - watch this space!|url=http://www.fiba.com/news/another-spanish-brother-combo-has-everyone-buzzing|website=[[FIBA]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Hernangómez has an older brother, [[Willy Hernangómez|Willy]], who currently plays with [[Real Madrid Baloncesto]]. Willy was drafted by the [[New York Knicks]] in the second round of the [[2015 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=El presente y futuro de los Hernangómez: Willy y Juancho apuntan alto... ¿NBA?|url=http://www.marca.com/2015/06/18/baloncesto/acb/1434611444.html|website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|accessdate=9 March 2016}}</ref> Their father, Guillermo, played with [[CB Estudiantes]] in the 1980s. Juan's sister, Andrea, also has experience with Estudiantes.<ref name=estudiantes/>
